statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, let q in k^* be a primitive third root of unity, and let A=U_q^+(B_2) be the algebra with exactly the two quantum Serre relations frozen in source.md. With e3=e1e2-q^2e2e1, z=e2e3-q^2e3e2, and z1=e1e2e3+e1z/(q^2-1)+e3^2/(q^4-1), one has Z(A)=k[e1^3,e2^3,e3^3,z,z1] and Aut_{Z(A)-alg}(A)={id_A}.
contribution: This settles the full frozen order-three case by a direct cubic Ore/PBW presentation, an exact associated-graded center and leading-term lift, and a center-fixing automorphism classification. It does not substitute the parameter into the nearest results stated for root order at least five, and it makes no claim of publication priority.
